sentences.text:
Ananya Bandyopadhyay, J.:-
1. Both the Learned Advocates representing the appellant/Insurance Company and the respondents/claimants are present.

2. The instant appeal had been filed against the judgment and award dated 23.08.2024 passed by the Learned Additional District Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Fast Tract Court, Suri,
Birbhum in M.A.C. Case No. 229/2022.
3.

Additional District Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Fast Tract Court, Suri,
Birbhum
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioners being the wife and other legal heirs of the deceased Somnath Dey filed an application under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 before the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-cum-Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, Suri, Birbhum in MAC Case No. 229 of 2022 claiming compensation of Rs.1,11,00,000/-(One Crore Eleven Lakhs Only) for the accidental death of the victim.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-cum-Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, Suri, Birbhum
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. The accident occurred on 08.01.2022 at approximately 11.05 a.m. while the victim was riding his motorcycle bearing registration no. WB54X-6862 along NH-60 accompanied by his wife (petitioner no. 1) as pillion rider, returning to Nakas from Rampurhat.

entities.text: Tata Aig General Insurance Company ... vs Payel Dey & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: When the victim reached near Robin Wood Mill at Deucha, a dumper truck bearing registration no. WB53C-1422 proceeding from Md. Bazar towards Rampurhat in the opposite direction hit the victim's motorcycle in a rash and negligent manner while being driven at a high speed.
6. As a result of the collision, the victim sustained grievous injuries and was immediately shifted to Suri Sadar Hospital where he was declared dead.
Petitioner no. 1 also sustained injuries and received treatment first at Suri Sadar Hospital and later at Burdwan.
7. Suri Police Station registered an unnatural death case being U.D. Case No. 10/2022 dated 08.01.2022 and prepared an inquest report in connection with the deceased's body.
8. The owner of the offending vehicle did not contest the case and the case proceeded ex parte against him.
9. Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited contested the aforesaid MAC Case.

entities.text: Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: 10. The learned Advocate representing the appellant/Insurance Company submitted that the learned Tribunal had granted loss of consortium to the extent of Rs.1,20,000/- instead of Rs.40,000/- and a default interest to the extent of 10% per annum.
11. The learned Advocate representing the respondents/claimants submitted that the learned Tribunal was justified in granting the compensation awarded.

12. Considered the rival contentions of the learned Advocates representing the respective parties.
13.

Since the occurrence of the accident, involvement of the offending vehicle, the driving license,
Insurance certificate etc. are not disputed by the learned advocate representing the appellant/insurance company, this Court restricts itself only to the extent of rectifying the compensation awarded in the following manner.

14. Considering the observations of the Hon'ble Apex Court in National insurance company Ltd. Vs.
Pranay Shetty & Anr1 and Sarala Verma & Ors. Vs. Delhi Transport Corporation & Anr.2, the impugned award of Rs. 47,99,000/- is modified as follows:-

sentences.text: The Respondents/claimants are entitled to receive the amount of Rs. 1,11,19,984/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per cent per annum from the date of filing of the claim application till the date of actual realization.

16. The learned Advocate representing the appellant/Insurance Company submits to have deposited a sum of Rs.1,29,56,140/- as per challan filed by the learned advocate representing the appellant/insurance company.

17. The office of the learned Registrar General, High Court at Calcutta, shall encash the cheques and thereafter disburse the entire awarded amount to the respondents/claimants as mentioned in the impugned judgment of the Learned Additional District Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Fast Track Court, Suri, Birbhum in M.A.C. Case No. 229 of 2022 on proof of proper identification of the respondents/claimants subject to payment of ad valorem Court fees and refund the balance amount through a cheque to the Learned Advocate for the Appellant/Insurance Company for the accounts of the insurance company.
18.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Fast Track Court, Suri, Birbhum
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The interest generated on the sum of money deposited by the appellant/insurance company at the office of the Learned Registrar General, High Court at Calcutta which has already been deposited in the nationalized bank by the office of the Learned Registrar General, High Court at Calcutta is to be apportioned and the sum of interest accrued on the aforesaid amount is to be disbursed in favour of the appellant/insurance company for the accounts of the insurance company.
19. The instant appeal is disposed of accordingly.
20. The pending applications, if any, stands disposed of.
